architecture.note: The stages follow the calls in MatchService.match; counts come from the EN lockbox run.

stages.guarantees: Headers are decided here, by rule, and never routed to the model. The output keeps the input's length and order; raw strings are kept.
stages.summary: Reads the BoQ by column name (UTF-8 first, cp1252 as a recorded fallback), decides which rows are headers and derives every row's section path over the whole file.
stages.title: Read

stages.guarantees: An unknown model or library falls back to the strictest threshold; the enrichment file must match the SHA-256 the policy certifies.
stages.summary: Resolves the policy per (model, library SHA-256) from config/policy.yaml, loads that entry's bilingual enrichment from data/enrichment/, and plans batches of contiguous items under one header, before any call.
stages.title: Plan

stages.guarantees: No shortlist: the right row is always in the prompt. Every attempt is recorded; a failure becomes needs review with a reason, never a lost line.
stages.summary: Every batch is read twice by the primary model against the whole enriched library: pass 1 over the canonical rendering, pass 2 over the reversed one. Each pass's first batch goes alone to write its cached prefix; the rest fan out.
stages.title: Two passes

stages.guarantees: A rescued line is never decided at the primary model's threshold, and the run records which lines the fallback served.
stages.summary: Only if the circuit breaker trips: the fallback model re-runs the pending lines at its own policy, the strictest threshold unless certified.
stages.title: Fallback rescue

stages.guarantees: A code that is not a row of the loaded library can never be emitted; below the threshold a line goes to review, never to a guess.
stages.summary: Closed-world check of every answer, evidence quoted from the line, hard attribute vetoes, then the D-rules and the score against the threshold: the lines the table would match.
stages.title: Validate + decision table

stages.guarantees: Only would-be matches are verified. A usage confusion caught here becomes VERIFIER_DISAGREES, not a wrong match.
stages.summary: Each would-be match is asked again among the sibling rows of its material type, in requests grouped by type; a disagreement sends the line to review.
stages.title: Sibling verifier (E-08)

stages.guarantees: One output row per input row. A replay of the committed run gives a byte-identical CSV at $0.
stages.summary: The final decision per line, then the output CSV, one audit record per line and one call record per attempt, written in input order with a manifest.
stages.title: Decide + write

releases.summary: The FR library is certified for the pinned model by the A10 smoke rule (A70).
G5 release: `oris explain` and `oris demo`, the four traced cases in `docs/traced-cases.md`, and the final README.
G4, the lockbox claim, scored once at `eval-freeze`
The configuration the lockbox scores (DESIGN.md §10.3), after the G3 readiness set.
G2 selection: the threshold, the sibling verifier and the enrichment were chosen on dev items only.
G1: the first submittable service, with the CLI, the API, the validators and the audit trail.
Pre-registration: the design, the evaluation protocol and the frozen split, committed before any model call.

smoke_fr.rule: 0 closed-world, 0 false not_a_material, 0 decoy matches, >= 9/18 base positives

traced_cases.input: No-fines drainage base under carriageway in cutting
traced_cases.takeaway: confidence was 68, the lowest bucket. `T8` accepts it because the two renderings agree with evidence, and that is the operating point the dev selection chose.

traced_cases.input: Couche de fondation en GNT recyclée 0/45, 300 mm, bretelles
traced_cases.takeaway: a usage confusion inside the right material type. It is the error class that remains (`docs/evaluation.md`).

traced_cases.input: Bulk dig in cutting, soil classes 3–5, surplus off site
traced_cases.takeaway: the right row is suggestion 2, so the engineer confirms it instead of searching the library. This is the abstention the design wants: no wrong match is written.

traced_cases.demonstrates: A failed call that ends in review
traced_cases.input: Clear vegetation, grub roots, trees ≤ 300 mm girth
traced_cases.takeaway: with one pass missing, rule D1 fails the line closed. It goes to `needs_review` with reason `BUDGET_CAP`, never to a guessed match.
